run_low_shot_training: run the low-shot classification training loop with base and novel classes from an HDF5 dataset file
create_lowshot_dataset: create a LowShotDataset that samples base and novel class examples with optional hallucination via a generator
run_evaluation_loop: run the eval_loop to compute top-1 and top-5 accuracy for base and novel classes on a test loader
create_test_loader: create a PyTorch DataLoader from an HDF5 file using SimpleHDF5Dataset for inference on test data
compute_per_element_accuracy: compute per-element top-1 and top-5 accuracy from model scores and ground truth labels
